name: Exodus
overview: The book of Exodus reveals God's sovereign plan in the formation and deliverance of Israel, beginning with the listing of the tribes who entered Egypt with Jacob's household. It highlights God's providence in preserving the house of Levi, from whom Moses emerges, and His direct intervention at Mount Horeb, where He commissions Moses to lead Israel out of bondage. The narrative emphasizes God's power to deliver His people with a strong hand, promising to compel Pharaoh to release them from Egypt.
